values.value: When a class is full, a learner can join its waitlist. When a seat opens it is offered to the next learner and held for {{Setting:Waitlist_Offer_Hours}} hours; the family is notified. An unanswered offer expires and passes to the next learner. A learner can be transferred to another class: the price difference is calculated; a cheaper class after invoicing creates credit.
